overall_goal: Perform various kitchen tasks including cleaning, organizing, and preparing utensils and ingredients.

goals.rationale: The person moves bottles to access the olive oil, then later closes and puts down a bottle of oil.

goals.description: Wash hands and soak the bowl
goals.rationale: The person washes their hands to remove stuck dough and uses the water to soak the empty bowl.

goals.description: Search for an item in the drawers
goals.rationale: The person opens and closes multiple drawers in search of a specific item but fails to find it.
The person moves various items like a water jug, notebook, dirty glass, and flour bag to clear space on the countertop.
The person opens cupboards to look for a lid, tests one on the pan, and returns it when it doesn't fit.

goals.description: Place a pot on the hob and turn it on
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a pot, checks if it is clean, places it on the hob, and switches the hob on.

goals.description: Clean the knife and handle the garlic
goals.rationale: The person slides the knife on the pan to remove stuck onion, puts it down, and handles a peeled garlic clove.

goals.description: Manage the wooden spoon and adjust the heat
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly handles the wooden spoon to keep it clean and adjusts the heat on the hob.
The person searches through drawers, moving items around to locate and retrieve a peeler for the carrots.
The person retrieves scissors from a drawer, removes their cover, and uses them to cut open the plastic bag of carrots.

goals.description: Search for and retrieve the garlic presser
goals.rationale: The person opens drawers and moves chopping boards to find and pick up the garlic presser.
The person gathers the paper and plastic from the empty meat package, tears it apart, and throws the pieces into the trash bin.

goals.description: Clean the countertop and discard trash
goals.rationale: The person wipes crumbs off the countertop into their hand and throws them into the trash bin.

goals.description: Store the salad in the fridge
goals.rationale: The person picks up a package of salad, opens the fridge, and places it inside.
